summary.motive: Weaponize the triple-option run identity to vacate the deep middle, then attack it with a post shot off an identical midline fake.
summary.whyItWorks: Option teams force safeties to trigger on every mesh; this fake sends both second-level defenders and the buzz safety downhill before the quarterback even looks downfield.
summary.failureMode: The safety plays run-pass split discipline instead of triggering, keeping his shoulders square to the post route developing behind the crosser.

beats.title: 1. Identical Midline Action
beats.text: Every tell from the midline triple is present: the same reverse pivot, the same seatbelt ride, the guard scooping past his key, and B driving the dive fake into the second level.

beats.title: 2. The Safety Trigger
beats.text: The buzz safety fires downhill on run action while the Mike triggers onto the diving back. Both vacate the middle of the field before the ball is ever thrown.

beats.title: 3. Rising Off the Fake
beats.text: The quarterback sells one more keep stride, then rises off the fake with a clean launch point. The crosser is dragging the free safety's eyes toward the boundary.

beats.title: 4. The Post Behind the Frozen Third
beats.text: Z breaks off his vertical into the post lane behind a middle-third defender who never recovered from the run fit. The shot lands over the trailing corner.

relations.tell: The slot releases upfield instead of running a pitch track, and the tackle arcs then resets to pass set — live option plays never do either.
